name: RC-B10-0156/2025 – After § 13 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 13a. Notes that in the rapidly changing geopolitical landscape, it is crucial to strengthen the Member States’ defence capabilities; emphasises that decision-making in the field of defence policy must remain a competence of the Member States; reiterates that any action related to defence must not aim to escalate tensions on the continent, but rather to reach a level that will deter any hostile actions while establishing and maintaining peace;
